about:
Eco Plastic Products of Delaware operates from Wilmington, Delaware, where it collects and recycles plastic waste into durable outdoor products. The organization’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company accepts clean, dry Polyethylene (#2 and #4) and Polypropylene (#5) plastics — such as bags, bottle caps, and containers — and transforms them into 100% recycled plastic park benches and tables. To date, it has diverted 160,790 pounds of plastic from landfills and waterways. Products are described as UV-protected, weather-resistant, and maintenance-free. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The organization sells its recycled plastic furniture directly as consumer goods, targeting individuals and groups seeking sustainable outdoor seating. Concrete customer types or industry verticals are not specified beyond the general consumer market.

Its stated mission is to reinvent how plastic waste is viewed by turning discarded material into purposeful products while fostering education, inspiring community action, and providing opportunities to people of all abilities.
